name: Yakushidou Shii
source:
"Excuse me! I'd like it if you were to die, please~"
Yakushidou Shii

Raised by the Yakushidou family, the only lineage of doctors within the village. A polite and well-mannered young lady, as well as deeply devoted. Although frail, she's wholly devoted to the ceremony, claiming she would even go as far as to kill in order to become the Divine Flower.

Flower: Purple Peony.
Bloom: [???]
Magic: [Shakushiki-no-Wa] — The ability to sense other's presence, within a limited range.
[Translated from [url=https://mahoumura.com/]Official Site[/url]]
